key_idea: Each note admits an integer interval of octave shifts, a block is singable iff those intervals intersect, and merging equal neighbouring blocks only helps, so it is a plain partition DP maximising the minimum block length.
sketch: For note a the valid shifts k satisfy ceil((l-a)/12) <= k <= floor((h-a)/12), non-empty because h-l>=11. dp[i] = max over j of min(dp[j-1], i-j+1) over blocks j..i whose running max-of-lows <= min-of-highs, extending j leftwards and breaking when the intersection empties. O(n^2) with n=1000. Adjacent blocks need not differ in shift because merging them never lowers the minimum. Pitfall: floor/ceil division on negative numbers. Stress-tested against an exponential brute force over all partitions.
